title.en: Amending Executive Order No. 674 Establishing the Research Institute for Tropical Medicine

text.en:
Section 3(b) of Executive Order No. 674 establishing the Research Institute for Tropical Medicine is
hereby amended to read as follows:
"The institute shall be headed by a Director who shall be assisted by an Assistant Director, with compensation
equivalent to CESO Rank II and CESO Rank III respectively, both of whom shall be appointed by the
President of the Philippines. The Director shall be responsible for the implementation of policies and the
immediate management of the programs and operations of the Institute."

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
